orb_recipe.source: .cx-ava from Personal mirror (branch personal/mirror-hub-20261119, blob 010dd56c) and Hub (blob 7a15413b), verbatim

letter.font: inherited sans (Inter / system sans) — NOT Marcellus (no 900 weight; certificate script face)

orb_recipe.body: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, rgba(255,255,255,.35) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 42%) over radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, color-mix(in srgb, COLOUR 55%, #101014) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, COLOUR 28%, #060607) 78%)
orb_recipe.rim: border 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, COLOUR 80%, white) (2px on 58px orb; scales with diameter)
orb_recipe.shadows: box-shadow 0 0 24px -4px COLOUR, inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.25), inset 0 -6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.55); all lengths scale with orb diameter
orb_recipe.animation_note: The live page has a spinning sheen ring (osOrbFlow, 7s). It is ANIMATION, not part of the static icon file, and is not drawn.

notes: TAB vs ORB colour for 5: the Hub TAB-colour table uses bright cyan #29b6f6 for 5 (verified from the fix-9 digit-5 tile). That is the TAB colour, NOT the orb colour. Orbs use the deep table: 5 = #0f52ba sapphire. #29b6f6 appears in NO orb file.

SQUARE-FILE ADAPTATION (coordinator's call): on the page the glow/drop-shadow extend ~0.4x the disc diameter beyond the disc. A square icon file cannot hold that proportionally, so disc diameter = 88% of canvas (450px in 512, 169px in 192), centred; border, highlight, body gradient, inset light/shade and letter at EXACT CSS proportions relative to the disc; outer glow and drop shadow scaled to fit the remaining margin (glow blur ~ margin x 0.6 fading to ~0 at canvas edge; drop-shadow offset ~ margin x 0.35, blur ~ margin x 0.5). Disc, rim, highlight, letter and colours are exact; only the atmospheric shadows are contained to the square. No sheen ring, no extra decoration.
Font: Inter variable (google/fonts Inter[opsz,wght].ttf), weight 900 via set_variation_by_axes
Canonical orb for an initial is the one whose colour number equals GEM_NUM[initial].
